supplementary_matrix.host_policy: Normal desktop; background load is informational, any deadline miss counts.

default.scope: Complete HRIR, branch and stereo PCM outputs including tails; same host, inputs and event schedule required

world_only.scope: Complete HRIR, branch and stereo PCM outputs including tails; same host, inputs and event schedule required

fixture.scope: Frozen geometry snapshots, all active direct/early image paths and all distance layers. CPU reference is production ResponseWork. Input-history and convolution checks use deterministic synthetic audio; not the Session event schedule, fade implementation, late field or complete tail acceptance.

commands.unit: cargo test --locked --no-default-features -p mradm-dsp --features room-gpu-experiment --lib gpu_tests --target aarch64-apple-darwin --target-dir $EXISTING_CARGO_TARGET
commands.session: cargo test --locked --no-default-features -p mradm-dsp --features room-gpu-experiment --test room_gpu --test room_quality --test room_no_alloc --target aarch64-apple-darwin --target-dir $EXISTING_CARGO_TARGET
commands.clippy: cargo clippy --locked --no-default-features -p mradm-dsp --features room-gpu-experiment --lib --example room_bench --example room_replay --test room_gpu --target aarch64-apple-darwin --target-dir $EXISTING_CARGO_TARGET -- -D warnings
commands.feature_compile: cargo check --locked --no-default-features -p mradm-dsp --features room-gpu-experiment,room-hoa-experiment --example room_bench --example room_replay --target aarch64-apple-darwin --target-dir $EXISTING_CARGO_TARGET

diagnostic.scope: One instrumented 512-call 32-source switch diagnostic, after all formal measurements. Not acceptance evidence. Nested/parallel stage times cannot be summed into a critical path; Windows thread CPU accounting is too coarse for individual calls.

binary_identity.scope: Instrumented diagnostic only, after completion of formal tests. No timing is substituted for unprofiled acceptance.

canonical_output.stderr: Error: "--trace requires a Release build with --features room-profile"

not_run: Final CPU 32-source switch comparison after GPU failure
Further expansion or macOS performance after supplementary switch failure
Native GPU 48 kHz, macOS GPU backend, production API/device callback integration, device-loss recovery, or other GPU models
notes: Source arithmetic changes remain opt-in. Default realtime policy stays room-realtime-v2; exact gate is not relaxed.
Default and world-only replays each contain 96013 input frames, 231581 total output frames, and 135568 actual post-EOS frames; manifest tail_frames is the initial room static value.
Formal executables and DLLs are frozen, archived and hash-verified across short, rounding, long and supplementary runs. Diagnostic binaries are separate.

The post-diagnostic unprofiled canonical rebuild has a different executable hash. It was checked to reject --trace as expected and was not used for any reported benchmark; results apply to the archived frozen binaries.
